intro: Samoa is made up of two large volcanic islands, Upolu and Savai'i, and several small ones.

chapters.title: Volcanic islands
text: Savai'i has lava fields from 1905–11 eruptions and blowholes. To Sua Ocean Trench on Upolu is a swimming hole in a giant collapsed lava tube.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The islands are hot and humid, with a wet season from November to April.

keyTerms.meaning: A hole where waves spray water upward.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Samoa's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
